request.task: Certify OBX-AUTH-R1-P2-SOLO-001 inside the wave-2 Release 1 governance change as corrected by the P2 predecessor-gate fix
request.head: ea2eccba6e3e0f4acba447226b5d96b41e1394f1

audit.proof_assessment: validatePredecessorGate PENDING_PREDECESSOR_MERGE now treats expectedAbsentFiles as a recording-time shape check (non-empty strings subset of binding.files) and does not inspect the tree for those paths. P2-only paths are refused only when they are outside predecessor.allowedPaths, outside P2_PRE_EXISTING_PHASE_ONLY_PATHS, and existsSync. The 13-pin is required to be P2-only and present; checkpointCommit must stay null; binding.files must equal the live predecessor allowedPaths; missing/expired/non-authorizing predecessor still fails; OBX-P210-* manifest rows still fail; COMPLETED_VERIFIED is still the hash-binding branch. Tests cover P1-created files passing, candidatePromotion.ts failing, files-list drift, dead/expired predecessor, and a manifest child ticket. They do not prove the 13 existed at 4b02f75f via git, do not exercise the fingerprint design-note tripwire, and the tolerate test would still pass if the pending gate were deleted. Independent of those tests: the 13 pin paths are absent from 4b02f75f..HEAD (unchanged, so they existed at base); the two P2-only new paths are also absent (not created). Registry records are hash-pinned and exact()-matched to PHASES, including expectedAbsentFiles.
residual_risks: P2_PRE_EXISTING_PHASE_ONLY_PATHS is a same-module constant checked with existsSync now, not git cat-file/show at 4b02f75f. Expanding the list and re-pinning the security-receipt hash of this module reclassifies a new P2 file as pre-existing and defeats predecessor-phase-not-merged.

The 13 P2-only pre-existing files are not content-frozen. P1 does not authorize them, so edits to pageIrMutation.ts, Workbench.tsx, canvas-contract.mjs, and the rest are P2 work; the gate cannot see them. P2-T01 and P2-T03 can start while verify:plans stays green.

Shared P1/P2 paths (contracts, pageIrController, releaseLifecycleStore, LifecycleStatus, preview-workbench) are attributed to P1 as soon as they exist. P2 can create or edit the four overlapping expectedAbsent files (store + LifecycleStatus) and the gate will call that predecessor work. That is the only new start path opened by dropping the live-absence check.

Only two presence tripwires remain: src/lib/candidatePromotion.ts and docs/plans/2026-09-02-release-1-p2-fingerprint-and-lock-order-design.md. That is thinner than the recorded activationPrecondition text (no OBX-P210 child ticket may start).
implementationAuthorized stays true on the pending P2 record. Any consumer that keys only on that flag treats P2 as live. The gate never queries whether P1 actually merged.
